column1: # Classification of the live Hyprland binds into blocks: kind <TAB> regex <TAB> block. First match wins (case-insensitive,
# re.search). kind `submap` matches the submap name, `desc` the bind description, `key` the label (super+ctrl+r, lower case).
# A bind no rule claims lands in block hypr-other, so a new bind is never lost.
